newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates fall to 21.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates fall to 21.5 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight rates fell on Thursday amid plenty of liquidity, dealers said.
The overnight money closed at around 21.5 percent, down from Wednesday's 22.25 close, after opening at between 22.00 and 22.125 percent.
"There's plenty of liquidity at the moment," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank. "People are probably taking their money out of the National Bank of Hungary after the repo rate cuts."
Szatmari said earlier considerable amounts had gone to the central bank in anticipation of Monday's 0.5 percent cut in four out of five repo rates.
